title: A site defines its own Story procedure
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-a29894.

`newsroom_process.STEPS` is one global list that gates publishing. Per-site procedure profiles are planned in PPY-7a61ca; Humorus needs them before its first automated piece.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #1422. Decision: site-rule kind 'procedure': the whole ordered step list ending with publish; built-in steps keep status/checks and may change words and optional; a step of the site's own is manual (findings note). Checklist, reminders, stories next and the publish rule follow it; the publish rule reads it strictly. Follow-up: the console's client-side manual-note hint (lib/story-checklist.ts MANUAL_STEP_KEYS) still lists built-in keys only; the server enforces.
